name: realmarket
description: Market research from verified, sourced numbers: real (inflation-adjusted) returns, returns in US dollars and gold, data-quality checks, company financials (official SEC filings for US companies) and news. Not investment advice.

price_provider.title: Price data provider
price_provider.description: Type yahoo to use Yahoo Finance for prices (unofficial; for personal research; you are responsible for Yahoo's terms). Leave empty to keep price tools off.

sec_contact.title: E-mail for SEC EDGAR (optional)
sec_contact.description: The SEC requires a contact e-mail in automated requests. With it, US companies' financial statements come from their official filings. No sign-up needed.

evds_api_key.title: TCMB EVDS API key (optional)
evds_api_key.description: Most current Turkish CPI. Without it Turkish inflation comes from the OECD, which can lag.

fred_api_key.title: FRED API key (optional)
fred_api_key.description: US CPI through the FRED API (agreeing to the FRED API Terms of Use). Not needed: the OECD gives the same BLS data without a key.
